title: Shillong
description: City and state capital of Meghalaya, India
extract: Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, India, is a hill station and the headquarters of the East Khasi Hills district. It is the 330th most populous city in India, with a population of 143,229 according to the 2011 census. The rolling hills around the town reminded the British of Scotland. Hence, they referred to it as the "Scotland of the East".
